Mapping of address to token balance; mutated by transfer and transferFrom.
Nested mapping of owner-spender allowances; mutated by approve, transferFrom and approveAndCall.

Returns _totalSupply minus balances[address(0)]; potential underflow if burned.
Constant view returning the balance of tokenOwner from balances mapping.
Transfers tokens from msg.sender to a recipient using safeSub/safeAdd.
Sets allowed[msg.sender][spender] to tokens and emits Approval.
Spends allowance and moves balances between from and to using SafeMath.
Constant view returning remaining allowance from the allowed mapping.
Sets allowance then performs an external receiveApproval callback on spender.
Payable fallback that always reverts; rejects ETH.
Owner-only rescue that calls transfer on an arbitrary ERC20 token address.
External caller address used for ownership, allowance keys and transfer authorization.
Arithmetic addition c = a + b with overflow check inside safeAdd.
Arithmetic subtraction c = a - b with underflow check inside safeSub.
Arithmetic multiplication c = a * b with overflow check inside safeMul.
Arithmetic division c = a / b with non-zero divisor check inside safeDiv.
Balances write in transfer: balances[msg.sender] = safeSub(balances[msg.sender], tokens).
Balances write in transfer: balances[to] = safeAdd(balances[to], tokens).
Balances write in transferFrom: balances[from] = safeSub(balances[from], tokens).
Allowance write in transferFrom: allowed[from][msg.sender] = safeSub(allowed[from][msg.sender], tokens).
Balances write in transferFrom: balances[to] = safeAdd(balances[to], tokens).
External callback call ApproveAndCallFallBack(spender).receiveApproval(msg.sender, tokens, this, data) in approveAndCall.
External call ERC20Interface(tokenAddress).transfer(owner, tokens) in transferAnyERC20Token.

edges.reason: Owned constructor writes the owner state variable.
msg.sender is assigned to owner, making caller identity the access-control root.
transferOwnership writes the newOwner state variable.
_newOwner parameter flows into transferOwnership logic.
_newOwner is stored into newOwner.
onlyOwner modifier compares msg.sender with owner before allowing transferOwnership.
acceptOwnership requires msg.sender == newOwner to authorize the takeover.
acceptOwnership promotes newOwner into owner.
acceptOwnership resets newOwner to address(0).
IUPToken constructor sets symbol.
IUPToken constructor sets name.
IUPToken constructor sets decimals.
IUPToken constructor mints the total supply.
IUPToken constructor assigns the full supply to the deployer address in balances.
totalSupply reads the _totalSupply state variable.
totalSupply subtracts balances[address(0)] from _totalSupply, an unchecked subtraction that can underflow if burned.
balanceOf reads the balances mapping.
tokenOwner parameter selects the balance entry.
balanceOf returns the looked-up balance.
transfer uses msg.sender as the source account.
transfer executes the debit of balances[msg.sender].
transfer executes the credit of balances[to].
msg.sender indexes the debited balance entry.
tokens parameter is subtracted from the caller balance.
Debit result is written into the balances mapping.
to parameter indexes the credited balance entry.
tokens parameter is added to the recipient balance.
Credit result is written into the balances mapping.
approve uses msg.sender as the allowance owner key.
approve writes the allowed mapping entry.
spender parameter is the second key of the allowed mapping.
tokens parameter is the allowance value stored in allowed.
transferFrom executes the debit of balances[from].
transferFrom executes the allowance debit of allowed[from][msg.sender].
transferFrom executes the credit of balances[to].
from parameter indexes the debited balance entry.
tokens parameter is subtracted from the from balance.
transferFrom debit is written into the balances mapping.
msg.sender is the spender whose allowance is consumed.
tokens parameter is subtracted from the allowance.
Reduced allowance is written back into the allowed mapping.
to parameter indexes the credited balance entry.
tokens parameter is added to the recipient balance.
transferFrom credit is written into the balances mapping.
allowance reads the allowed mapping.
tokenOwner parameter is the first allowance key.
spender parameter is the second allowance key.
remaining is returned from the allowance lookup.
approveAndCall writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] before the external callback.
approveAndCall keys the allowance on msg.sender.
spender parameter is the allowance key in approveAndCall.
tokens parameter is stored as the allowance value.
approveAndCall performs an external call to an attacker-controlled contract.
spender parameter is the external callback target address.
msg.sender is forwarded to the callback as the from argument.
tokens parameter is forwarded to the callback.
attacker-controlled data bytes are forwarded to the callback.
External receiveApproval callback can reenter approveAndCall or transferFrom before state settles.
transferAnyERC20Token is guarded by onlyOwner checking msg.sender.
transferAnyERC20Token invokes an external contract chosen by the caller, gated by onlyOwner.
tokenAddress parameter is the arbitrary external contract being called.
tokens parameter is the transferred amount.
External token transfer sends the rescued tokens to the owner state variable.

normalization_plan.reason: Parameter a feeds directly into the addition unsafe operation of safeAdd.
Parameter b feeds directly into the addition unsafe operation of safeAdd.
Return variable c is produced by the addition unsafe operation of safeAdd.
Parameter a feeds directly into the subtraction unsafe operation of safeSub.
Parameter b feeds directly into the subtraction unsafe operation of safeSub.
Return variable c is produced by the subtraction unsafe operation of safeSub.
Parameter a feeds directly into the multiplication unsafe operation of safeMul.
Parameter b feeds directly into the multiplication unsafe operation of safeMul.
Return variable c is produced by the multiplication unsafe operation of safeMul.
Parameter a feeds directly into the division unsafe operation of safeDiv.
Parameter b feeds directly into the division unsafe operation of safeDiv.
Return variable c is produced by the division unsafe operation of safeDiv.
Parameter _newOwner is only used inside transferOwnership to set newOwner.
Parameter tokenOwner is only used inside balanceOf as a mapping key.
Return variable balance is only used inside balanceOf.
Parameter to is only used inside transfer to credit the recipient balance.
Parameter tokens is only used inside transfer for the debit and credit amounts.
Parameter spender is only used inside approve as the allowance key.
Parameter tokens is only used inside approve as the allowance value.
Parameter from is only used inside transferFrom as the debited account.
Parameter to is only used inside transferFrom as the credited account.
Parameter tokens drives all three SafeMath writes inside transferFrom.
Parameter tokenOwner is only used inside allowance as the first mapping key.
Parameter spender is only used inside allowance as the second mapping key.
Return variable remaining is only used inside allowance.
Parameter spender is both the allowance key and the target of the external callback call.
Parameter tokens is the allowance value and an argument of the external callback call.
Parameter data is forwarded verbatim into the external callback call.
Parameter tokenAddress is the arbitrary external contract invoked by the rescue call.
Parameter tokens is the amount passed to the external transfer call.
Return variable success only carries the result of the rescue function call.
